test_title: PYST 49: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: The radii of the ends of a frustum of a solid right-circular cone 45 cm high are 28 cm and 7 cm. If this frustum is melted and reconstructed into a solid right circular cylinder whose radius of base and height are in the ratio 3 ∶ 5, find the curved surface area (in cm²) of this cylinder. [Usе π = (22)/(7)]
solution:
**Given:**

Height of the frustum is 45 cm

Radii of the ends of a frustum are 28 cm and 7 cm

The ratio of radius of base to height of cylinder is 3 : 5

**Formula Used:**

**1.** Volume of frustum = (1/3)πH(R² + Rr + r²)

**2.** Volume of cylinder = πR²H

**3.** Curved Surface Area of cylinder = 2πRH

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Volume of frustum = Volume of cylinder

⇒ (1/3) × π × 45 × [282 + (28 × 7) + 72] = π × (3x)2 × (5x)

⇒ (1/3) × 45π × 1029 = π × 9x² × 5x

⇒ (1/3) × 45π × 1029 = 45π × x³

⇒ x3 = (1/3) × 1029 = 343

⇒ x = 7

Now, for cylinder

Radius of base of cylinder = 3x = 21 cm

Height of cylinder = 5x = 35 cm

Curved Surface Area of cylinder = 2π × 21 × 35

⇒ Curved Surface Area of cylinder = 4620 cm²

**∴ The curved surface area of the cylinder is 4620 cm².**
